<Property>
            <Name>ParticipantMessages</Name>

            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Array</DataType>
              <Name>MessageTriggers</Name>
              <DataSet>ParticipantMessageTrigger</DataSet>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>Reactions</Name>
                  <Description>The conditions for all Reactions will be checked from top to bottom. As soon as one is Fulfilled, The Reaction is triggered and the evaluation is stopped.</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                      <Name>DisabledForGameType</Name>
                      <DataSet>GameType</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                      <Name>MyRole</Name>
                      <DataSet>ParticipantMessageRole</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredDiplomacyState</Name>
                      <Description>Reaction is only executed when the two related participants have one of the required diplomacyStates. Empty = Dont Care. (All Checked = Dont Care, but Empty is Recommended)</Description>
                      <DataSet>DiplomacyState</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredReputationState</Name>
                      <DataSet>ParticipantMessageReputation</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredReputationParticipant</Name>
                      <DataSet>ParticipantID</DataSet>
                      <AllowEmpty>1</AllowEmpty>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredReputation</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredContextAsset</Name>
                      <Description>Type of asset depends on trigger (e.g. a buildingAsset for CREATE_CULTURAL_BUILDING).  If a message has an asset as precondition, it will only be executed if the trigger relates to the same asset</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredContextMenu</Name>
                      <Description>Reaction is only executed when the given menu is currently opened</Description>
                      <DataSet>GUIState</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>RequiredContextValueThreshold</Name>
                      <Description>-1 = Ignore this Requirement. Some Triggers are Fired with a ContextValue (e.g. "Propaganda" can be slight(0), medium(1), heavy(2), ...). If you set this value to X, than the reaction is triggered for all values <= X.</Description>
                      <Min>-1</Min>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Float</DataType>
                      <Name>Probability</Name>
                      <Description>If this trigger occurs, how likely (0.0 = never, 1.0 = always) will the reaction be executed?</Description>
                      <Min>0</Min>
                      <Max>1</Max>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>ProbabilityIsOneForFirstOccurence</Name>

                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>IgnoreFirstOccurences</Name>
                      <Description>How many Triggers should be ignored before the first Reaction is Executed? 0 = Execute on first Trigger Occurence</Description>
                      <Min>0</Min>
                      <Max>255</Max>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>CooldownOccurences</Name>
                      <Description>After an Execution of this Reaction, how many Triggers are ignored before the next Reaction is Executed? 0 = Execute on every consecutive Trigger Occurence.</Description>
                      <Min>0</Min>
                      <Max>255</Max>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Time</DataType>
                      <Name>CooldownTime</Name>
                      <Description>After an Execution of this Reaction, how much time has to pass before this Reaction is allowed to be Executed again?</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                      <Name>SideEffect</Name>
                      <Description>Should the Reaction Execute Any Side Effects? (Details for the Side Effect can be configured in EffectValue). Note: Reputation Changes always Change What THIS profile thinks of the other one (human / other).</Description>
